# PayKonnect

PayKonnect is the third-party payroll route behind some named payroll vendors.

## Route behavior

- PayKonnect is a third-party payroll provider that vendors use to send files to and receive files from Transamerica.
- The global SFTP connection is named PAYKONNECT.
- Paycor and Rippling both route through PAYKONNECT and both use the standard file format.
- Capture the client-named payroll vendor, but let Jen/Eric confirm whether the actual route is PAYKONNECT.
- Uses Transamerica loan numbers. No PGP.
